edits.before: Q-poke the contacts and count your notes — every third spell sings twice.
edits.after: His long first-shot range and W root threat beat your weak level-1 trade before you can step up.

edits.before: W-sustain trades begin: the duo shield-heal makes even exchanges dishonest.
edits.after: His burst and root setup punish any step-up at 2 — his kit is ahead of your damage.

edits.before: E-chains open: slow into root is the lane's longest pick at 3.
edits.after: Full W root plus 4th-shot combo pressure gives him the level-3 all-in, not you.

edits.before: First item spike: echoed Qs chunk and the note ledger compounds.
edits.after: His first-item empowered autos and W root re-spike before your own item catches up.

edits.before: - Jhin Deadly Flourish (Root): matchup-defining — The cross-map root chains off any damage you took — never linger after a trade. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Beat Drop for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: Deadly Flourish (W) is 12s cooldown and roots off any prior damage — don't linger after a trade. Curtain Call channels; your E or R stun cancels it outright. Track true HP — Whisper and Curtain Call execute below a threshold, not zero.

edits.before: Echoed Q the contact, W the trade-back, E the disengage — the song taxed, healed, and rooted in one verse.
edits.after: Cast W for the shield, then let the echo heal — timed into a Jhin trade it beats his burst 4th shot.

edits.before: Spending the echo on a plain W out of rhythm — the third note is the champion; wasting it is singing scales.
edits.after: Standing in front eats his W root off your own body and strips your support's peel angle.
